purpose: Versioned review calendar for the protected US catalog. This policy schedules checks but does not publish or mutate records.

cycles.label: Technical facts and source pages
checks: manufacturer page or manual still supports the recorded facts
dimensions, capacity and electrical facts have evidence
changed model identity is mapped explicitly

cycles.label: Offers, prices and delivery scope
checks: destination and tracking URL still resolve to the exact configuration
availability, price scope and last successful check are current

cycles.label: Program, promotion and image rights
checks: account approval and permitted promotion types are evidenced
image or feed permission is recorded before use
a declined or expired relationship blocks the affected surface

status_rules.candidate: Research only. No public page or offer is implied; assign the first technical review when the record is ready.
status_rules.draft: Content or data is being prepared and requires a named review before promotion.
status_rules.reviewed: Technical and source review is recorded, but public release still needs the applicable publication gates.
status_rules.published: Only permitted after the release, legal, rights and offer checks are recorded.
status_rules.retired: Keep the record for traceability, remove it from public selection and do not revive it automatically.

publication_rule: A review report may recommend changes, but only a reviewed JSON change and the existing publication switches can alter output.
